name: Click Buffer
description: Buffers early inputs and improves input consistency across game modes.

guide.name: Timing guide
guide.description: Timing windows are measured in ticks at the selected Game Speed (TPS). At 240 TPS, one tick is about 1/240 second; four ticks are about one frame at 60 FPS. -1 uses the Main Buffer Window, 0 turns a mode off, and positive values set a custom window.

stage.name: Main Buffer Window
stage.description: Default timing window for modes set to -1. Bigger windows are more forgiving but can cause inputs to fire earlier or later than intended.

sec-ground.name: Landing and orb modes
sec-ground.description: Cube, Ball, Robot and Spider remember a released early click and fire it when you land or touch an orb.

sec-safe-jump.name: Predictive Cube Jump (Experimental)
sec-safe-jump.description: For grounded cube clicks, simulates now and delayed timings from a checkpoint. It chooses the earliest timing that survives the prediction horizon; if none survives or no checkpoint is available, it retries while the cube stays grounded rather than forcing an unchecked jump. Simulation can stutter.

safe-jump.name: Safe Jump Timing
safe-jump.description: Intercept grounded cube clicks and test candidate jump frames for survival before replaying the click. Experimental; checkpoint simulation can stutter. Use practice mode first.

safe-jump-frames.name: Safe Jump Window (frames)
safe-jump-frames.description: Maximum delay candidates to test for a survivable jump timing (1-10 frames, scaled by TPS). If none survives, it keeps retrying on later grounded frames.

safe-jump-horizon.name: Prediction Horizon (physics steps)
safe-jump-horizon.description: How far after a candidate jump to simulate when checking survival. Longer horizons can catch later collisions but take more time.

cube-ticks.name: Cube Window (ticks)
cube-ticks.description: How early a released click can be remembered before landing or touching an orb. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables buffering.

ball-ticks.name: Ball Window (ticks)
ball-ticks.description: How early a released click can be remembered before landing or touching an orb. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables buffering.

robot-ticks.name: Robot Window (ticks)
robot-ticks.description: How early a released click can be remembered before landing or touching an orb. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables buffering.

spider-ticks.name: Spider Window (ticks)
spider-ticks.description: How early a released click can be remembered before touching a surface or orb. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables buffering.

sec-fly.name: Flying modes
sec-fly.description: Ship, UFO and Swing taps can be stretched to a minimum hold duration. Wave has its own timing modes.

ship-ticks.name: Ship Window (ticks)
ship-ticks.description: Minimum duration for short ship taps. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables it.

ufo-ticks.name: UFO Window (ticks)
ufo-ticks.description: Minimum duration for short UFO taps. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables it.

swing-ticks.name: Swing Window (ticks)
swing-ticks.description: Minimum duration for short swing taps. -1 uses the main window; 0 disables it.

wave-ticks.name: Wave Window (ticks)
wave-ticks.description: Strength of Min Hold, Min Gap or Grid timing. -1 uses the main window but is capped at 8 ticks; 0 disables wave timing.

wave-mode.name: Wave Mode
wave-mode.description: Min Hold stretches short taps. Min Gap enforces a minimum pause after release. Grid snaps presses and releases to a fixed timing grid. Change while paused.

sec-keys.name: Hotkeys
sec-keys.description: Windows hotkeys used during a level. Choose None to disable a hotkey.

key-stage.name: Key: Cycle Main Window
key-stage.description: Cycles the main window through 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks and Off.

key-tps-up.name: Key: TPS Up
key-tps-up.description: Selects the next Game Speed (TPS) preset.

key-tps-down.name: Key: TPS Down
key-tps-down.description: Selects the previous Game Speed (TPS) preset.

key-wave.name: Key: Cycle Wave Mode
key-wave.description: Switches Min Hold, Min Gap and Grid. Best used while paused.

sec-general.name: General
sec-general.description: Settings that apply to every mode.

tps.name: Game Speed (TPS)
tps.description: Set this to the TPS you actually use. It converts timing ticks to real time; it does not change the game's speed. Use 240 if you have not changed the game TPS.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.description: Prints detailed input-buffer events to the Geode log. Leave disabled for normal play.
